import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    ref_customers = inputs["ref_customers"].copy()
    ref_skus = inputs["ref_skus"].copy()
    
    # Initialize rejection reason column
    orders["rejection_reason"] = None
    
    # R1: customer_id not present in ref_customers
    valid_customers = set(ref_customers["customer_id"])
    mask_r1 = orders["rejection_reason"].isna() & ~orders["customer_id"].isin(valid_customers)
    orders.loc[mask_r1, "rejection_reason"] = "CUST_UNKNOWN"
    
    # R2: customer status <> 'ACTIVE'
    # Join with ref_customers to get status
    orders_with_status = orders.merge(
        ref_customers[["customer_id", "status"]], 
        on="customer_id", 
        how="left"
    )
    mask_r2 = (orders["rejection_reason"].isna() & 
               (orders_with_status["status"] != "ACTIVE"))
    orders.loc[mask_r2, "rejection_reason"] = "CUST_INACTIVE"
    
    # R3: sku not present in ref_skus
    valid_skus = set(ref_skus["sku"])
    mask_r3 = orders["rejection_reason"].isna() & ~orders["sku"].isin(valid_skus)
    orders.loc[mask_r3, "rejection_reason"] = "SKU_UNKNOWN"
    
    # R4: sku discontinued = 1
    sku_discontinued = dict(zip(ref_skus["sku"], ref_skus["discontinued"]))
    orders["is_discontinued"] = orders["sku"].map(sku_discontinued)
    mask_r4 = orders["rejection_reason"].isna() & (orders["is_discontinued"] == 1)
    orders.loc[mask_r4, "rejection_reason"] = "SKU_DISC"
    
    # R5: allowed_countries non-empty AND ship_country not in the delimited list
    sku_allowed_countries = dict(zip(ref_skus["sku"], ref_skus["allowed_countries"]))
    
    def check_country_allowed(row):
        if pd.isna(row["rejection_reason"]):
            allowed_str = sku_allowed_countries.get(row["sku"], "")
            # Empty or NULL means ALL countries allowed
            if pd.isna(allowed_str) or allowed_str == "":
                return False  # No rejection
            # Parse trimmed comma-delimited list
            allowed_list = [c.strip() for c in allowed_str.split(",")]
            if row["ship_country"] not in allowed_list:
                return True  # Should reject
        return False
    
    mask_r5 = orders.apply(check_country_allowed, axis=1)
    orders.loc[mask_r5, "rejection_reason"] = "CTRY_BLOCKED"
    
    # Split into clean and rejects
    orders_clean = orders[orders["rejection_reason"].isna()].copy()
    orders_rejects = orders[orders["rejection_reason"].notna()].copy()
    
    # Keep only original columns for clean
    original_cols = ["order_id", "customer_id", "sku", "qty", "ship_country"]
    orders_clean = orders_clean[original_cols]
    
    # Keep original columns + reason_code for rejects
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects[original_cols + ["rejection_reason"]].copy()
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects.rename(columns={"rejection_reason": "reason_code"})
    
    return {
        "orders_clean": orders_clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "orders_rejects": orders_rejects.reset_index(drop=True)
    }
